text:
mira: FYI getting a bunch of inbound tickets — hosted inference (eu-west2) seeing 502s + intermittent timeouts since ~06:12 UTC. Customers report auth retries and long tail latencies. Any one else seeing this in dashboards?

sam: yep alerting spike at 06:11-06:18, 502 rate up ~8x on gateway. Latency p95 from eu-west2 jumped from 120ms -> 1.2s. Traces show TCP retransmits and TLS handshake delays.

jia: I see noise on the peering graphs to Peer-ASN 64512 around 06:10. BGP route churn and some withdraws to our eu-west2 interconnect. Provider dashboard shows flapped session, then re-established.

mira: reproduced quickly with curl from eu-west2: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -d '{"model":"vicuna-13b","prompt":"hi"}'``` response: HTTP/1.1 502

emma: customers include two mid-market PLG apps — both saw request-level 502s and billing hooks retried. I've told them we're investigating and provided temporary retry guidance.

sam: grabbing tcpdump from a problematic host (edge node eu-west2-azb): ```
06:10:58.123456 IP 10.1.2.3.443 > 10.4.5.6.51234: Flags [P.], seq 123:345, ack 678, win 64240
06:10:58.223511 IP 10.1.2.3.443 > 10.4.5.6.51234: Flags [P.], seq 345:567, ack 780, win 64240 (retransmission)
06:11:02.345678 IP 10.4.5.6.51234 > 10.1.2.3.443: Flags [R], seq 780, ack 567
``` This looks like packet loss + RSTs mid-handshake.

jia: provider confirms a soft reboot of their edge box caused buffered packet drops; some of their sessions triggered route recalculation -> transient asymmetry. They pushed a fix at 06:20 but we're seeing residual microbursts.

kai: mitigation idea: switch critical customer traffic to eu-west1 region via routing policy and enable shorter TCP keepalive on gateway (reduce handshake tail). Can we trigger low-risk reroute?

sam: I've applied a routing policy to steer canary subset (20%) to eu-west1 and enabled session fallback for legacy clients. Early telemetry shows 502s falling for the canary.

mira: Support note to customers: ask them to set client side retries with exponential backoff (max 3) and include idempotency keys. We're logging all samples for post-mortem.

emma: added a support tag to affected customers and scheduled 1:1 with top two tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

incident-bot: INCIDENT #INC-2026-453 created (regional-network-eu-west2-provider-flap) assigned to eng-sre.

ops-bot: Automated rollback disabled for current route policy. Monitoring alarm adjusted: p50/p95 token latency split by region.

sam: follow-ups: (1) netops to chase provider RCA and BGP session stability (jia) (2) runtime to add aggressive KV cache bypass for auth flows during rollbacks (sam) (3) support to notify customers and capture repro payloads (emma).

jia: provider RCA indicates hardware NIC firmware bug that triggered transient packet duplication and kernel-level drops during route convergence. They've scheduled firmware push to edge fleet tonight 23:00 UTC and will stagger. We'll verify with extended synthetic probe.

mira: assign action items to incident ticket and mark P1 until we confirm stability for 24h. Also capture sample request IDs for billing reconciliation (some customers saw duplicate webhook charges).

kai: confirmed canary rollback completed at 07:05 UTC -> regional error rates down to baseline by ~07:20. Keeping reroute in place until provider firmware roll goes through.

emma: closing loop with customers: sent summary + mitigation steps, asked for any remaining errored request IDs.

sam: logging notes in postmortem: include tcpdump snippet, BGP withdraw timestamps, peer ASN 64512 correlation, and suggestion: add automated region failover for auth-heavy paths.

mira: thanks all. I'll own postmortem and customer follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
